items.mnemonic_text: A log splits clean down the middle, and you're left holding the half with three snapped branch-stumps still bristling out to the left, the spine running straight down your right hand. That splintered off-cut is the <radical>left-side kata</radical> — one half of a broken pair.

items.mnemonic_text: Three strokes crowded down the left edge: a short flick at the top, then a long stroke dropping and curving, then a leg kicking out. It is a beast in profile, all snout and haunch, pressed up against the side of the character and ready to bolt. Whenever this is on the left, the word is about an <radical>animal</radical>.

items.mnemonic_text: A short flat top with one leg dropping straight down at the left and another hooking under at the right. Nothing in the middle at all. It is the plainest piece of furniture anyone ever built: a slab held up on two legs, room enough underneath for your knees. A <radical>table</radical>.
